name: Vizionfocus Inc.
summary: Established in 2011 and based in Miaoli, Taiwan, Vizionfocus Inc. operates as a manufacturer of various sophisticated products. The company primarily produces medical equipment, serving key markets across Taiwan, China, Japan, and the United States. Its manufacturing capabilities also encompass mechanical equipment, optical instruments, and precision instruments. Beyond its production activities, Vizionfocus engages in global trade and delivers consultancy services. A significant area of its business involves the full lifecycle of contact lenses, from initial research and development to design, production, and wholesale distribution.
